editorial:
Imagine moving into a new place and finding a best friend who is just as pregnant as you are. That is exactly what happens to Emily, who meets her new neighbor, Kelly. They bond over baby clothes and pregnancy cravings, and it feels like a dream. The vibe starts out sweet and cozy, but you can tell something is off. It quickly turns into a tense game of cat and mouse as you realize Kelly is not who she says she is. The tension builds up perfectly, making you feel the dread as Kelly gets closer and closer to Emily's life.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing about how far Kelly will go. The acting is solid for a TV movie, and the pacing keeps the story moving without getting boring. While some of the plot twists are easy to spot, the payoff is still exciting. If you love those creepy neighbor stories, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a scary confrontation when Kelly finally reveals she was never pregnant. She used a fake belly to trick Emily so she could steal her baby to replace a child she lost. After a tense struggle, Emily manages to fight back and protect her newborn. The police arrive just in time to arrest Kelly, and Emily is finally safe. It wraps up with Emily holding her baby, knowing the nightmare is over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about secret identities.
